 SNL alum Heidi Gardner's boyfriend, 43, dies as cause of death still under investigation
 We'll be bringing you the very latest updates, pictures and video on this breaking news story.
 Add to preferred sources Entertainment Angelica Cheyenne 19:15 ET, 16 Nov 2026 Updated 19:51 ET, 16 Nov 2026 View Image (Image: Todd Williamson/NBC via Getty Im) 
 Saturday Night Live alum Heidi Garnder's boyfriend filmmaker Ray Tintori has died at the age of 43.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 TMZ reported on Monday, November 16, that the New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner that Ray's death was being investigated so the cause and manner of death is still being determined. Insiders close to the 43-year-old comedian revealed to the news outlet that she was grieving the loss, and during this difficult time she's surrounded by family and friends.
 When Heidi and Ray initially started dating is unclear; however, he did dedicate a post to her in July 2025, writing she was "Prettier and more graceful than the moon and by far the coolest person I've ever met."
 READ MORE : SNL fans declare ‘he’s back’ as show favorite returns to take on role of ex-Nvidia CEO READ MORE : 'Donald Trump' appears on SNL UK cold open as US show swaps cast Additionally, before his death, he shared photos that captured the two of them together at the time, including a snap of them kissing each other and another in which she looked at him sweetly.
 Ray became famous in the late 2000s for his career as a short film and music video director. Also, he was a part of Court 13, which is a filmmaking collective that made the movie "Beasts of the Southern Wild."
 Ray's death broke the heart of his fans, with many mourning him on X, formerly known as Twitter. One wrote on X, "RIP Ray Tintori man gone too soon for real damn."
 ‌ 
 Another expressed, "Heartbreaking news. Gone far too soon at just 43. Sending love, strength, and condolences to his family and loved ones."
 Someone else shared, "Thts so sad :(. Praying for his family," while one other remarked, "SAD NEWS: Filmmaker Ray Tintori, known for directing MGMT's iconic music videos 'Kids' and 'Electric Feel,' has reportedly died. Cause of death is unknown at this time. Tintori was in a relationship with former SNL star Heidi Gardner. Rest in peace."
 ‌ 
 Heidi achieved success as cast member on Saturday Night Live from 2017 until she was fired after the 2025 season, and before dating Ray she was married to Marvel writer Zeb Wells.
 The Missouri native initially joined SNL during Season 43 as a featured character, and during that season Luke Null and Chris Redd were also added to the cast, both of whom have since departed.
